title_sq: SHITET VILE EKSKLUZIVE TE KOMPLEKSI "SIAR" , LIQENI FARKES, TIRANE
description_sq:
Kompleksi rezidencial "Siar" esht i pozicionur ne zonen e jug-lindore te qytetit te Tiranes. Kjo vendodhje ne nje nga zonat me elitare te qytetit, prane liqenit te Farkes, ofron kushtet ideale per nje jetese te shendetshme, mes ajrit te paster dhe gjelberimit.
Kompleksi perbehet nga 33 vila dy kateshe dhe hapesirat rekreative, te dedikuara per nje standart me te lart jetese. Vilat jane projektuar ne menyre te tille, per tju pershtatur kerkesave te nje komuniteti te pergjedhur rezidentesh.
Perparesite e Rezidences jane:
1. Arkitektura- Zgjidhje moderne te arkitektures dhe konstruksionit qe ofrojne komfort, siguri dhe jetegjatesi.
2. Privatesia-Hyrje individuale per cdo Ville per te ofrouar privatesi, qetesi dhe mjedis te shendetshem familjar.
3. Pejsazhi - Pamje relaksuese e ambjenteve te jashtme, fale shtrirjes se terrenit dhe afersise me Liqeni Farkes
4. Komuniteti – Komuniteti I perzgjedhur rezidentesh.
5. Natyra – Zona ofron nje oaz me gjelberim te perhershem, ajer te paster, pamje te mrekullueshme buze liqenit te Farkes
6. Facilitetet – Zone ne zhvillim. Afersi me shkolla, spitale, sherbime. Pike referimi per aktivitete te jashtme, sport, lundrim
7. Cilesi e larte ndertimi
Vila bashkangjitur TIP E9
Kati Nentoke (Parkim + Depo) – 93.8m2 neto
Kati Perdhe - 86.8m2 neto
Kati I Pare - 88.2m2 neto
Verande - 9.1m2
Total siperfaqe ndertimi 277.9 m2 neto dhe Parcele 168.1m2
Organizimi viles : 
Kati Perdhe : ambient ndenjie me dalje ne oborr , kuzhine , korridor shperndares , 1 tualet , 1 lavanteri .
Kati 1: 3 dhoma gjumi , korridor shperndares , 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone te bollshme.
Kati -1 : Parkim per 2 automjete dhe depo
-Mundesi pages me KESTE
title_en: EXCLUSIVE VILLA FOR SALE IN "SIAR" COMPLEX, FARKES LAKE, TIRANA
description_en: The residential complex "Siar" is located in the south-eastern area of ​​the city of Tirana. This location in one of the most elite areas of the city, near the Farka lake, offers the ideal conditions for a healthy lifestyle, between clean air and greenery. The complex consists of 33 two-story villas and recreational spaces, dedicated to a higher standard of living. The villas are designed in such a way, to suit the needs of a selected community of residents. The advantages of the Residence are: 1. Architecture - Modern architecture and construction solutions that offer comfort, safety and longevity. 2. Privacy-Individual entrance for each Villa to provide privacy, tranquility and a healthy family environment. 3. Landscape - Relaxing view of the outdoor areas, thanks to the extension of the terrain and the proximity to Lake Farkes 4. Community - Selected community of residents. 5. Nature - The area offers an oasis with permanent greenery, clean air, wonderful views of the Farka lake 6. Facilities - Area under development. Close to schools, hospitals, services. Reference point for outdoor activities, sports, sailing 7. High construction quality Attached villa TYPE E9 Ground floor (Parking + Storage) - 93.8m2 net Ground floor - 86.8m2 net First floor - 88.2m2 net Veranda - 9.1m2 Total construction area 277.9 m2 net and Plot 168.1m2 Villa organization: Floor Ground floor: living room with access to the yard, kitchen, distribution corridor, 1 toilet, 1 laundry room. 1st floor: 3 bedrooms, distribution corridor, 2 bathrooms and 2 spacious balconies. Floor -1: Parking for 2 vehicles and warehouse - Possibility of payment by CASH
